beats.objective: Carry the lamp to the door below

first_night.speaker: patron
first_night.text: {patron.first} {patron.family} nods at the robed figures passing {patron.place}. "{faith.name}. They say the city has a bottom, {courier.first}, and something waits there."

pilgrims.speaker: patron
pilgrims.text: More pilgrims every night, heading down through the stair cores with lamps and bundles. {enforcer.name} start counting them.

pilgrim_door.speaker: pilgrim
pilgrim_door.text: {pilgrim.first} {pilgrim.family} packs the rations with shaking hands. "{prophet.first} says the door below opens this week. Will you come and see?"

prophet_meet.speaker: prophet
prophet_meet.text: {prophet.first} {prophet.family} smiles as if expecting you. "Couriers know every door. Take our lamp to the one below and you'll see I'm not mad."

skeptic_door.speaker: skeptic
skeptic_door.text: {skeptic.first} {skeptic.family}, a surveyor, spreads the map. "There's no bottom — just old pump halls, flooded. People will drown chasing a sermon."

below_door.speaker: below
below_door.text: Behind {below.name} a stair goes down into cold air and the sound of water. Pilgrims crowd behind you; {enforcer.name} wardens come up the stairs.

epilogue_open.speaker: prophet
epilogue_open.text: The pilgrims go down singing. Some come back with stories; some don't come back. {faith.name} grows by the week.

epilogue_seal.speaker: skeptic
epilogue_seal.text: {skeptic.first} welds the door shut with you watching. The pilgrims curse you, then drift home to their families.

epilogue_sell.speaker: enforcer
epilogue_sell.text: {enforcer.name} post a guard and a fee at the door below. Faith, it turns out, is good business.
